messages:
sam: Hey — first week! Quick q: I set up my laptop and want to post a pic + ask about monitor arm reimbursement and what channel to ask for Slack bot opt-ins (calendar, jira). Also stuck on VPN access to private repos.
olivia: welcome sam :tada: For hardware/reimbursements post in #people-ops with the receipt and tag @people-ops. For photos, #random is fine if you want to share. For procurement or receipts use people-ops thread, not this channel.
it-bot: To request VPN or repo access, run `/it-request access vpn repo:<team-repo>` or open the IT ticket at https://redwood.example.com/it/new
jordan: For bot notifications: subscribe in #devex-bots — use `!subscribe jira` or visit https://tools.redwood/subscriptions
lee: One note: don't post credentials/screenshots with tokens. Blur them or use code blocks with dummy values.
devex: Also if you want to opt into the calendar bot, DM @devex-bot with `opt-in calendar` — defaults are off.
ben: If you're joining eng teams, ping your manager in #eng and include the repo names. I can pre-warm access if you list them here.
sam: Thanks all! Trying `/it-request access vpn repo:web-core` now... will post receipt to #people-ops. Appreciate the quick answers :pray:
it-bot: Ticket created — IT-3421. We'll update in this thread when granted.
jordan: tagging checklist: onboarding doc -> https://wiki.redwood/in/onboarding (has channel map + what-to-post-where). If anything missing lmk.
olivia: Also FYI: call outs — use threads for async ops questions, DMs for 1:1, and @channel sparingly (only infra incidents). Welcome again!
sam: Got it, thanks everyone :heart:
